feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 7 October 2026 11:39am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 07 October 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing for a time.


##Synopsis##

Strengthening northwesterly airstream will cover the Irish Sea today, before a ridge of high pressure builds tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Wind##

North or Northwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 later this afternoon or early this evening, then decreasing 4 or 5 again later tonight or at first tomorrow morning. Further decreasing West or Northwest 3 or 4 later tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building mainly moderate later today, falling slight later tonight and tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, becoming fair later tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 3 or 4, backing West or Southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon, then backing and increasing South or Southwest 5 to 7 in evening. Staying Southwest 5 or 6 overnight into Friday, veering West on Friday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate or rough.


##Weather##

Rain spreading from the west, heavy at times, clearing on Friday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.
